name: Debug Bar
description: A simple floating toolbar with debug information.
project_description: Debug Bar adds a small floating toolbar to the front end that surfaces at-a-glance runtime information for a page request: Drupal and PHP versions, execution time, peak memory usage, database query count, page/dynamic cache status, the last cron run, the current Git branch, and quick links to the status report, log and the current user. Admins can trigger a cron run or a full cache clear directly from the bar. Everything is gated behind the module's own permissions and rendered via a middleware plus a kernel event subscriber so the metrics stay accurate even for cached responses.
